narrative.details:
adventurer,

In times past you have served the interests of the Argent Dawn, always to the best of your abilities. Now, once again, we sound the clarion call in our time of greatest need.

adventurer, please report to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands if you are willing to aid us once more.
narrative.objectives: Take the Letter from the Keeper of the Rolls to him at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
narrative.offerRewardText: Simply by answering the call, we are in your debt, adventurer. The Argent Dawn is certain that through your shining example, others that are here to aid us will gain great insight into how best to throw back this Scourge Invasion!
narrative.requestItemsText: Ah, adventurer, it is good to see you.
